Process/reprocess the given date(s) in production or in a test environment.

- YYYYMMDD-YYYYMMDD
- YYYYMMDD

If processing in a test environment, please provide a short name to be used to name the configuration file and a short description of what the processing is being done: to test a certain calculation, to determine a particular threshold, etc.
